name: Speak with Ruga
label: Quest
description: Speak with Ruga: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are a warrior of skill and growing renown. Perhaps you are ready for Ruga Ragetotem's trial? If so, then find Ruga in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
He awaits those warriors who answer his call.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are here for my trial, friend?
